● The detector matches the prompt box, for example:

    Do you want to proceed?
    ❯ 1. Yes
      2. Yes, and don't ask again
      3. No, and tell Claude what to do differently (esc)

  and nothing else.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
❯ 
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ⏵⏵ bypass permissions on (shift+tab to cycle)
